company and relevant members.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 47. Conditions and
procedures for conducting meetings of the Board of Members</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The meeting shall be conducted
when it is participated by a number of members that hold at least 65% of
charter capital; <i>a specific ratio shall be specified in the company's
charter.</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. In case the conditions for
conducting the first meeting specified in Clause 1 of this Article are not
fulfilled and the company's charter does not provide for this situation
otherwise, the following actions shall be taken:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The invitation to the second
meeting shall be sent within 15 days from the first meeting date. The second
meeting shall be conducted when it is participated by a number of shareholders
that hold at least 50% of charter capital;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) In case the conditions for
conducting the second meeting of the Board of Members prescribed in Point a of
this Clause are not fulfilled, the invitation to the third meeting shall be
sent within 10 days from the second meeting date. The third meeting shall be
conducted regardless of the number of charter capital held by the participants.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. In case the duration of a
meeting is longer than the expected one, it may be extended but must not exceed
30 days from its opening date.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 48. Resolutions and
decisions of the Board of Members</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Board of Members shall
ratify its resolutions and decisions by voting at the meeting, questionnaire
survey or another method specified in the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Unless otherwise prescribed by the
company's charter, a resolution or decision on one of the following issues
shall be voted on at the meeting:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Revisions to the company's
charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Orientation for development of
the company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Election, dismissal of the
Chairperson of the Board of Members; designation, dismissal of the Director or General
Director;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Ratification of the annual
financial statements;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Reorganization or dissolution
of the company.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) It is voted for by a number of
participants that hold at least 65% of total stakes of all participants, except
the case in Point b of this Clause;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) It is a resolution or decision
to sell assets whose value is at least 50% of total assets written in the
latest financial statements <i>or a smaller ratio or value specified in the
company's charter,</i> a resolution or decision on revisions to the company's
charter, reorganization or dissolution of the company, and is voted for by a
number of participants that hold at least 75% of the total stakes of all
participants;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. It will be considered that a
member participates in and votes at the meeting of the Board of Members in the
following cases:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The member directly participates
in and votes at the meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The member authorizes another
person to participate in and vote at the meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The member participates and
votes online or through other electronic methods;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The member sends the votes to
the meeting by post, fax or email.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. In case of questionnaire survey,
a resolution or decision will be ratified when it is voted for by a number of
members that hold at least 65% of charter capital; <i>a specific ratio shall be
specified in the company's charter.</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 49. Minutes of meetings
of the Board of Members</b></p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The minutes shall be ratified
right before the meeting ends and contain the following information: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Time, location, purposes and
agenda of the meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Full names, holdings, numbers
and dates of issues of capital contribution certificates of participating
members and their authorized representatives; full name, stakes, numbers and
dates of issues of capital contribution certificates of non-participating
members and their authorized representatives;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The issues that are discussed
and voted on; summaries of the members’ comments on each issue;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Quantities of valid votes,
invalid votes, affirmative votes, negative votes and abstentions on each issue;
</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Ratified decisions and
corresponding ratio of affirmative votes;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Full names, signatures and
comments of participants who disagree with the ratification of the minutes (if
any);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Full names, signatures of the
minutes taker and the chair of the meeting, except the case in Clause 3 of this
Article.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. In case the chair and the minutes
taker refuse to sign the minutes, the minutes will be effective if they are
signed by other members of the Board of Members and contain all information prescribed
in Points a, b, c, d, dd and e Clause 2 of this Article.  The minutes shall
clearly state the reasons why the chair and the minutes taker refuse to sign
them.  The persons who sign the minutes shall be jointly responsible for the
accuracy and truthfulness of the minutes.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Unless otherwise prescribed by the
company's charter, a questionnaire survey on ratification of resolutions or decisions
of the Board of Members shall be carried out as follows: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Chairperson of the Board of
Members shall decide to carry out a questionnaire survey on ratification of
resolutions and decisions within its jurisdiction.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The Chairperson of the Board of
Members shall organize the drafting and sending of reports on the issues, the
resolution or decision and questionnaires to members of the Board of Members. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. A questionnaire shall contain:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The company’s name, enterprise
ID number, headquarter address;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Full name, contact address,
nationality, number of ID card, citizen identity card or passport or other
valid personal identification papers of the individual, or the member’s
holding; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The issue that needs voting,
options including affirmative, negative and abstentions; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The deadline for submission of
the answered questionnaire;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Full name and signature of the
Chairperson of the Board of Members.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The survey issue and purposes;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Full names, holdings, numbers
and dates of issue of capital contribution certificates of members that
submitted their answered questionnaires; full names, holdings, numbers and
dates of issue of capital contribution certificates of members whose
questionnaires are not submitted or invalid;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The issues that are voted on;
summaries of the members’ comments on each issue (if any);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The numbers of valid, invalid
and unsubmitted questionnaires; numbers of valid questionnaires that contain
affirmative votes, negative votes and abstentions on each issue;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) The ratified resolutions and/or
decisions and corresponding ratio of affirmative votes;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Full names and signatures of the
vote counters and the Chairperson of the Board of Members. The vote counters
and the President of the Board of Members shall be jointly responsible for the
legitimacy, accuracy and truthfulness of the vote counting report.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 51. Effect of
resolutions and decisions of the Board of Members</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. Unless otherwise prescribed by
the company's charter, a resolution or decision of the Board of Members shall
take effect from the day on which it is ratified or from the effective date
specified therein.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. A resolution or decision that is
ratified with 100% of total charter capital shall be lawful and effective even
if the procedures for ratification of such resolution or decision are not
followed.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 52. Controllers and Board
of Controllers</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Board of Controllers shall
have 01 – 05 Controllers. The term of office of a controller shall not exceed
05 years, and may be re-appointed without term limit. In case the Board of Controllers
only has 01 controller, he/she shall be the Chief Controller and shall satisfy
corresponding conditions.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The Chief Controller and
Controllers shall satisfy the standards and requirements specified in Article
88 and Article 90 of the company's charter and the Law on Enterprises.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. Rights, obligations,
responsibilities, dismissal and works of Controllers and the Board of
Controllers are specified in Articles 89, 90, 91 and 92 of this Charter and the
Law on Enterprises.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 53. Responsibilities of Chairperson
of the Board of Members, General Director (Director), other executives, legal
representatives and Controllers</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Chairperson of the Board of
Members, General Director (Director), other executives, legal representatives
and Controllers have the following responsibilities:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Exercise and perform their rights
and obligations in an honest, prudent and best manner to protect the company’s
lawful interests;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Be loyal to the company’s
interests; do not abuse their power and position or use the company’s information,
secrets, business opportunities and assets for personal gain or serve any other
organization’s or individual’s interests;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Promptly, accurately and fully
notify the company of the enterprises that they own or have shares/stakes or
that their related persons own, jointly or separately own controlling
shares/stakes;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The Director or General Director
shall not have a pay rise or bonus when the company is not able to pay its due
debts.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. The notification mentioned in
Point c Clause 1 of this Article shall be made in writing and contain the
following information:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Names, enterprise ID numbers and
headquarters addresses of the enterprises they own or have shares/stakes in;
the holdings and time of owning or holding the shares/stakes;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Names, enterprise ID numbers and
headquarters addresses of the enterprises their related persons own, jointly or
separately own controlling shares/stakes enterprises.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The notification mentioned in
Clause 3 of this Article shall be sent within 05 working days from the day on
which the event or change occurs. The company shall compile a list of the
entities mentioned in Clause 3 of this Article, their contracts and transactions
with the company. This list shall be kept at the company’s headquarters. Members,
executives, Controllers and their authorized representatives are entitled to
see, copy part or all of the information specified in Clause 3 of this Article
during office hours following the procedures specified in the company's
charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 54. Contracts and
transactions subject to approval by the Board of Members</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. Contracts and transactions
between the company and the following entities are subject to approval by the
Board of Members:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Members and their authorized
representatives, Director or General Director, or the company’s legal
representative;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Related persons of the persons
mentioned in Point a of this Clause;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Related persons of the persons
mentioned in Point c of this Clause.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The person who concludes a
contract or carries on a transaction on behalf of the company shall send a
notification to members of the Board of Members and the Controllers of the
related entities and interests of such contract or transaction together with
the draft contract or description of the transaction. Unless otherwise
prescribed by company's charter, the Board of Members shall decide whether to
approve or disapprove the contract or transaction within 15 days from the day
on which the notification is received and follow the instructions in Clause 2
Article 48 of this Charter. Members of the Board of Members who are related to
the parties to the contract or transaction must not vote.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. A contract or transaction shall
be invalidated under a court decision and handled as prescribed by law when it
is concluded or carried out against regulations of Clause 1 and Clause 2 of
this Article. The person who concludes the contract or carries out the
transaction, related members and their related persons shall pay compensation
for any damage caused and return the benefits generated by such contract or
transaction to the company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Section II. SINGLE-MEMBER LIMITED
LIABILITY COMPANY</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 55. Organizational
structure of a single-member limited liability company owned by an organization</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>(The company’s charter shall
specify specific provisions)</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 56. Board of
Members                          </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Board of Members shall have
03 – 07 members. The members of the Board of Members shall be designated and
dismissed by the company’s owner with a 5-year term of office. The Board of
Members shall perform the owner’s rights and obligations in the owner’s name; perform
the company’s rights and obligations in the company’s name, except the rights and
obligations of the Director or General Director; take responsibility to the law
and the company’s owner for their performance as prescribed by this charter,
the Law on Enterprises and relevant laws. Rights, obligations and working
regulations of the Board of Members shall comply with the company's charter,
the Law on Enterprises and relevant laws.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The Chairperson of the Board of
Members shall be designated by the company’s owner or elected by members of the
Board of Members under the majority rule following the procedures specified in
the company's charter. Unless otherwise prescribed by the company's charter,
the term of office, rights and obligations of the Chairperson of the Board of
Members shall comply with Article 45 of this Charter and relevant regulations.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. A meeting of the Board of
Members shall be conducted when it is participated in by at least two thirds of
the members. Unless otherwise prescribed by the company's charter, each member
of the Board of Members shall have one vote with equal value.  Resolutions and
decisions of the Board of Members may be ratified by questionnaire survey.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. A resolution or decision of the
Board of Members will be ratified when it is voted for by more than 50% of the
participating members or by a number of participating members that hold more
than 50% of the total votes. Revisions to the company's charter, reorganization
of the company, transfer of all or part of the company’s charter capital must
be voted for by at least 75% of the participating members or by a number of
participating members that hold more than 75% of the total votes.  A resolution
or decision of the Board of Members takes effect from the day on which it is
ratified or on the effective date written therein, unless otherwise prescribed
by the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. Minutes of every meeting of the
Board of Members shall be taken. Audio recording or electronic forms are
optional. Minutes of meetings of the Board of Members shall comply with Clause
2 Article 49 of this Charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 57. Company’s President </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The company’s President shall be
designated by the company’s owner. The company’s President shall perform the
owner’s rights and obligations in the owner’s name; perform the company’s
rights and obligations in the company’s name, except the rights and obligations
of the Director or General Director; take responsibility to the law and the
owner for his/her performance as prescribed by this charter, the Law on
Enterprises and relevant laws. Rights, obligations and working regulations of
the company’s President shall comply with the company's charter, the Law on
Enterprises and relevant laws.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. A decision of the company’s
President on performance of rights and obligations of the company’s owner shall
be effective from the day on which it is approved by the owner, unless
otherwise prescribed by the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 58. Responsibilities of
members of Board of Members, company’s President, General Director (Director),
other executives and Controllers</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. Comply with regulations of law,
the company's charter, and decisions of the company’s owner in performance of
their rights and obligations. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. Perform their rights and
obligations in an honest and prudent manner to serve the best and lawful
interests of the company and its owner.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. Promptly, accurately and fully
notify the company of the enterprises that they own or have shares/stakes or
that their related persons own, or jointly or separately own controlling
shares/stakes. The notification shall be retained at the company’s
headquarters.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. Discharge other responsibilities
as prescribed by the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 59. Organizational
structure of a single-member limited liability company owned by an individual </b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>(The company’s charter shall
specify specific provisions)</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 60. Contracts and
transactions between the company and related persons</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. Unless otherwise prescribed by
the company's charter, contracts and transactions between a single-member
limited liability company owned by an organization and the following persons
are subject to approval by the Board of Members or the company’s President,
Director or General Director and Controllers:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The company’s owner and his/her
related persons; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Members of the Board of Members,
the company’s President, Director or General Director and Controllers;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Related persons of the persons
mentioned in Point b of this Clause;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Related persons of the persons
mentioned in Point d of this Clause.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The person who concludes a
contract or carries on a transaction in the company’s name shall send a
notification to the Board of Members or the company’s President, Director or General
Director and Controllers of the related persons and interests; the notification
shall be enclosed with the draft contract or summary of the transaction.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. Unless otherwise prescribed by
the company's charter, members of the Board of Members or the company’s
President, Director or General Director and Controllers shall decide whether to
approve the contract or transaction within 10 days from the receipt of the
notification under the majority rule. Each person shall have one vote; related
persons of the parties shall not vote.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. A contract or transaction
mentioned in Clause 1 of this Article shall only be approved if the following
conditions are fully satisfied:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The parties to the contract or
transaction are independent legal entities that have separate rights,
obligations, assets and interests;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The prices applied to the
contract or transactions are market prices at the time the contract is
concluded or at the time the transaction is conducted;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The company’s owner fulfills the
obligations specified in Clause 4 Article 33 of this Charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. A contract or transaction shall
be invalidated under a court decision and handled as prescribed by law when it
is concluded or carried out against regulations of Clauses 1, 2, 3 and 4 of
this Article. The person who concludes the contract or carries out the
transaction and related persons of the parties shall jointly pay compensation
for any damage caused and return the benefits generated by such contract or
transaction to the company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. Every contract or transaction
between a single-member limited liability company owned by an individual and
the company’s owner or related persons of the owner shall be recorded in
separate documents of the company.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 61. Organizational
structure of a joint-stock company</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><i>(The company’s charter shall
specify specific provisions)</i></p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b> 
General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS)</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 62. Rights and
obligations of GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The GMS shall consist of all
voting shareholders and is the supreme body of  the company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The GMS has the following rights
and obligations:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Ratify the orientation for
development of the company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Decide the types of authorized
shares and quantity of each type; decide the annual dividends of each type of
shares;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Elect, dismiss members of the
Board of Directors and Controllers;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Decide revisions to the
company’s charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Ratify annual financial
statements;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Decide repurchase of more than
10% of total sold shares of each type;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>h) Take actions against violations
committed by members of the Board of Directors or Board of Controllers that
cause damage to the company and its shareholders;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>i) Decide reorganization or
dissolution of the company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>k) Decide the budget or total
salaries, bonuses and other benefits of the Board of Directors and the Board of
Controllers;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>l) Approve the rules and
regulations of the company, the Board of Directors and the Board of
Controllers;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>m) Approve the list of independent
audit companies; choose independent audit companies that shall carry out audit
of the company; dismiss independent audits where necessary;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>n) Perform other rights and obligations
prescribed by the company's charter.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The GMS shall be convened
annually. In addition to annual meeting, the GMS may meet whenever necessary.  The
meeting location is the place where the chair attends and shall be within Vietnam’s territory.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The annual GMS shall be convened
within 04 months from the end of the fiscal year. Unless otherwise prescribed
by the company's charter, the Board of Directors shall decide deferral of the
annual GMS where necessary by up to 06 months from the end of the fiscal year. The
following issues shall be discussed and ratified at the annual GMS:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The company’s annual business
plan;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The annual financial statements;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The report of the Board of
Directors on its performance and that of each of its members;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The report of the Board of
Controllers on the company’s business performance, performance of the Board of
Directors, General Director (Director); </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) The report of the Board of
Controllers on its performance and that of each controller;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Dividend of each type of shares;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Other issues within its
jurisdiction.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The meeting is necessary for the
company’s interests;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The quantity of remaining
members of the Board of Directors and Board of Controllers is smaller than the
minimum quantity prescribed by law;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The meeting is requested by the
shareholder or group of shareholders mentioned in Clause 2 Article 10 of this
Charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The meeting is requested by the
Board of Controllers;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) The meeting is convened in
other cases prescribed by law and the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. Unless otherwise prescribed by
the company's charter, the Board of Directors shall convene the GMS within 30
days from the date of occurrence of the event mentioned in Point b Clause 3 of
this Article or the day on which the request for holding the meeting mentioned
in Point c and Point d Clause 3 of this Article is received. If the Board of
Directors fails to convene such GMS, the Chairperson and members of the Board
of Directors shall pay compensation for the damage incurred by the company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. In case the Board of Directors
fails to convene a GMS as prescribed in Clause 4 of this Article, the Board of
Controllers shall convene a GMS within the next 30 days in accordance with
regulations. If the Board of Controllers fails to convene the GMS, it shall pay
compensation for the damage incurred by the company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. In case the Board of Controllers
fails to convene a GMS as prescribed in Clause 5 of this Article, the
shareholder or group of shareholders prescribed in Clause 2 Article 10 of this Charter
may convene the GMS on behalf of the company in accordance with regulations. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>7. The person who convenes the GMS
shall:</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Provide information and settle
complaints relevant to the aforementioned list;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Prepare documents for the
meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Draft the resolution of the GMS
according to the meeting agenda; prepare a list and detailed information about
the candidates for members of the Board of Directors and Controllers (in case
of election);</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Determine the meeting time and
location;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Send the invitation to each
shareholder entitled to participate in the GMS as prescribed in this Charter; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>h) Perform other tasks serving the
meeting.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>8. The costs of convening and
conducting the GMS as prescribed in Clauses 4, 5 and 6 of this Article shall be
reimbursed by the company.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 64. List of shareholders
entitled to participate in the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The list of shareholders
entitled to participate in the GMS shall be compiled according to the company’s
shareholder register. The list shall be compiled not more than 10 days before
day on which the invitations to the GMS are sent if a shorter period is not
specified in the company's charter.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. Shareholders are entitled to
access and make copies of names and contract addresses of shareholders on the
list; request correction of errors or addition of information about themselves
on the list. The company’s executives shall promptly provide information in the
shareholder register, revise and add information as requested by the
shareholders; pay compensation for damage caused by the failure to provide or inaccurately
or lately provide information about shareholder register as requested. The
procedures for requesting provision of information in the shareholder register
shall be specified in the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 65. Agenda of the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The person who convenes the GMS
shall prepare the agenda.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The shareholder or group of
shareholders specified in Clause 2 Article 10 of this Charter is entitled to
propose additional issues to the GMS agenda. The proposal shall be made in
writing and sent to the company at least 03 working days before the opening
date, unless another period is specified in the company's charter.  The
proposal shall contain the shareholder’s name and the proposed issues.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. In case the proposal mentioned
in Clause 2 of this Article is rejected by the person who convenes the GMS, a
written response, in which reasons for rejection must be specified, must be
provided at least 02 days before the opening day. A proposal may only be
rejected in the following cases:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The proposal is sent against the
regulations of Clause 2 of this Article;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The issue exceeds the
jurisdiction of the GMS;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Other cases prescribed by the
company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The person who convenes the GMS
shall include the issues proposed in accordance with Clause 2 of this Article
in the draft agenda, except in the cases specified in Clause 3 of this Article;
The issues will be included in the official agenda if their inclusion is
accepted by the GMS.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The person who convenes the GMS
shall send invitations to all shareholders on the list of shareholders entitled
to participate in the GMS at least 21 days before the opening day, unless a
longer period is specified in the company's charter. The invitation shall
contain the participant’s name, headquarters or contact address, enterprise ID
number, time and location of the meeting and other requirements.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. Invitations shall be sent to
contact addresses of the shareholders and posted on the company’s website. If
necessary, the invitation may be published on a local or central daily
newspaper as prescribed by the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. An invitation shall be sent
together with:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The meeting agenda, meeting
documents and the draft resolution on each issue in the agenda;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The votes.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The invitation and meeting
documents mentioned in Clause 3 of this Article may be uploaded on the
company’s website (if any) instead of sending physical invitations and
documents. In this case, the invitation shall contain instructions on how to
download the documents.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 67. Exercising the right
to attend the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. Shareholders and authorized representatives
of shareholders that are organizations may directly participate in the GMS or
authorize one or some other organizations and individuals to participate in the
GMS, or participate in the GMS in one of the forms specified in Clause 3 of
this Article.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The authorization of
participants in the GMS shall be made in writing. The authorization letter
shall be made in accordance with civil laws and specify the name of the
authorized participant, the quantity of shares authorized. The authorized
participant shall present the authorization letter before entering the meeting
room.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The shareholder directly
participates in and votes at the meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The shareholder authorizes
another organization or individual to participate in and vote at the meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The shareholder participates and
votes online or through other electronic methods;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The shareholder sends the votes
to the GMS by post, fax or email;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) The shareholder sends the votes
by other means specified in the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 68. Conditions for
conducting the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The GMS shall be conducted when
it is participated by a number of shareholders representing more than 50% of
total votes; (<i>the specific ratio shall be specified in the company's
charter).</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. In case the conditions for
conducting the first meeting specified in Clause 1 of this Article are not
fulfilled, the second invitation shall be sent within 30 days from the first
meeting date, unless otherwise prescribed by the company's charter. The second
GMS shall be conducted when it is participated by a number of shareholders representing
at least 33% of total votes; <i>(the specific ratio shall be specified in the
company's charter).</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. In case the conditions for
conducting the second meeting specified in Clause 2 of this Article are not
fulfilled, the third invitation shall be sent within 20 days from the second
meeting date, unless otherwise prescribed by the company's charter. In this
case, the GMS shall be conducted regardless of the number of votes represented
by the participants.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 69. Meeting and voting
protocol</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Unless otherwise prescribed by the
company's charter, the following meeting and voting protocol shall be followed:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The shareholders that
participate in the GMS shall be registered before the meeting is declared open;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. Election of the chair, secretary
and election board:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The Chairperson of the Board of
Directors shall assume the role of the chair or authorize a member of the Board
of Directors to chair the GMS if it is convened by the Board of Directors. In
case the chair is not present or is temporarily unable to work, the remaining
members of the Board of Directors shall elect one of them as the chair of the
meeting under the majority rule. In case a chair cannot be elected, the chief
of the Board of Controllers shall preside over the election of the chair of the
meeting of the GMS, in which case the person that receives the most votes will
be the chair;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Except for the cases specified
in Point a of this Clause, the person that signs the decision to convene the
GMS shall preside over the election of the chair by the GMS, in which case the
person that receives the most votes will be the chair;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The chair shall designate one or
some persons as the secretary(ies) of the GMS;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The GMS shall elect one or some
people as the election board as requested by the chair.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. The meeting agenda shall be
ratified by the GMS during the opening session. The agenda shall specify the
duration of each issue therein.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. The GMS shall discuss and vote
on each issue included in the meeting agenda. Votes include affirmative votes,
negative votes and abstentions. The voting result shall be announced by the
chair before the meeting ends, unless otherwise prescribed by the company's
charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. Shareholders or their authorized
participants that arrive at the meeting after it is declared open will be
registered and have the right to vote after registration. In this case,
previous voting result shall remain unchanged.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>7. The person who convenes or chairs
the GMS has the rights to:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Request all participants to
facilitate inspection and other lawful and reasonable security measures; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Request a competent authority to
maintain order during the meeting; expel those who do not comply with the
chair’s instructions, deliberately disrupt order, obstruct the meeting progress
or disobey security requirements.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>8. The chair is entitled to
postpone the GMS that has a sufficient number of participants for up to 03
working days from the initial opening date or change the meeting location in
the following cases:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The current meeting location
does not have enough seats for all participants; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Communication devices at the
current meeting location are not adequate for all participants to discuss and
vote;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) One or some participants disrupt
or obstruct the meeting and thus threaten the fairness and legality of the
meeting.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 70. Methods for
ratifying resolutions of the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The GMS shall decide
ratification of resolutions by voting or questionnaire survey.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. Unless otherwise prescribed by
the company's charter, resolutions of the GMS on the following issues shall be
voted on at the meeting:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Revisions to the company's
charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Orientation for development of
the company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Types of shares and quantity of
shares of each type;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Election or dismissal of members
of the Board of Directors and the Board of Controllers;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Investment or sale of assets
that are worth at least 35% of the total assets written in the latest financial
statements of the company, <i>unless another ratio or value is specified in the
company's charter;</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Ratification of annual financial
statements;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 71. Conditions for
ratification of resolutions of the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. A resolution on one of the
following issues will be ratified if it is voted for by a number of
shareholders that represent at least 65% <i>(a specific ratio shall be
specified in the company's charter)</i> of votes of all participants, except
for the cases specified in Clauses 3, 4 and 6 of this Article:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Types of shares and quantity of shares
of each type;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Change of the company’s business
lines;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Change of the company’s
organizational structure; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Investment in or sale of assets
that are worth at least 35% of the total assets written in the latest financial
statement, <i>unless another ratio or value is specified in the company's
charter;</i></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Reorganization or dissolution
of the company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Other issues specified in the
company’s charter. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. A resolution will be ratified
when it is voted for by a number of shareholders that hold more than 50% <i>(a
specific ratio shall be specified in the company's charter)</i> of the votes of
all participants, except for the cases specified in Clauses 1, 3, 4 and 6 of
this Article.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. In case of questionnaire survey,
a resolution will be ratified when it is voted for by a number of shareholders
that hold more than 50% <i>(a specific ratio shall be specified in the
company's charter)</i> of the votes of all voting shareholders.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. A resolution of the GMS shall be
notified to the shareholders having the right to participate in the GMS within
15 days from the day on which it is ratified. It may be also uploaded on the
company’s website (if any) instead of sending the physical notification.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. A resolution on adverse changes
to rights and obligations of preference shareholders may only be ratified if it
is voted for by a number of preference shareholders that participate in the
meeting and hold at least 75% of the same kind of preference shares. In case of
questionnaire survey, it needs to be approved by a number of preference shareholders
that hold at least 75% of the same kind of preference shares.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 72. Power and method for
ratifying resolutions of the GMS by questionnaire survey</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Unless otherwise prescribed by the
company's charter, a questionnaire survey on ratification of a resolution of
the GMS shall be carried out as follows:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Board of Directors is
entitled to carry out questionnaire survey to ratify a resolution of the GMS
when it is considered necessary for the company’s interests, except for the
cases specified in Clause 2 Article 70 of this Charter; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The Board of Directors shall
prepare the questionnaires, the draft resolution and explaining documents, and
send them to all voting shareholders at least 10 days before the deadline for
submission of the questionnaires, unless a longer period is specified in the
company's charter. The list of shareholders to receive the questionnaires shall
be compiled in accordance with Clause 1 and Clause 2 Article 64 of this
Charter. Questionnaires and documents shall be sent in accordance with Article
66 of this Charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. A questionnaire shall contain:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The company’s name, enterprise
ID number and headquarter address;  </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) If the shareholder is an
individual: full name, contact address, nationality, number of ID card or
citizen identity card or Passport or another valid personal identification
paper; if the shareholder is an organization: name, number of enterprise
registration certificate or establishment decision or other document of
equivalent validity, and headquarters address of the organization or full name,
contact address, nationality, number of ID card or citizen identity card or
Passport or another valid personal identification paper of the organization’s
representative; quantity of shares of each type and number of votes of the
shareholder; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) The issues that need voting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) The options including
affirmative, negative and abstention;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Deadline for submission of the
answered questionnaire;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Full name and signature of the
Chairperson of the Board of Directors;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. Shareholders may send answered
questionnaires to the company by post, fax or email as follows:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) An answered questionnaire sent
by post shall bear the signature of the shareholder (if the shareholder is an
individual) or the shareholder’s authorized representative or legal
representative (if the shareholder is an organization. The answered
questionnaire shall be placed in a closed envelope which must not be opened
before the vote counting time;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) An answered questionnaire sent
by fax or email shall be kept confidential until the vote counting time; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Answered questionnaires that are
submitted after the deadline or opened before the vote counting time (for those
sent by post) or revealed (for those sent by fax or email) shall be considered
invalid.  Questionnaires that are not submitted shall not be counted as votes.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The company’s name, enterprise
ID number and headquarter address;  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Purposes and the issue that
needs voting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Quantities of voters, votes
casted, valid votes and invalid votes, voting method and the list of voters;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Quantities of affirmative votes,
negative votes and abstentions on each issue; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Ratified decisions and
corresponding ratio of affirmative votes;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Full names and signatures of the
Chairperson of the Board of Directors, vote counting supervisors and vote
counters.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The members of the Board of
Directors, vote counters and vote counting supervisor are jointly responsible
for the accuracy and honesty of the vote counting record; for the damage caused
from the decisions that are ratified due to inaccurate or dishonest vote
counting.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. The vote counting record and the
resolution shall be sent to all shareholders within 15 days from the date of
completion of the vote counting. Such record and resolution may be also
uploaded on the company’s website (if any) instead of sending the physical
ones.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>7. Answered questionnaires, the
vote counting record, the ratified resolution and relevant documents enclosed
with the answered questionnaires shall be retained at the company’s
headquarters.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 73. Minutes of the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. Minutes of every meeting of the
GMS shall be taken. Audio recording or electronic forms are optional. The
minutes shall be taken in Vietnamese language, may be translated into foreign
language, and shall contain the following information: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The company’s name, enterprise
ID number and headquarter address;  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Time and location of the GMS;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) The meeting agenda;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Full names of the chair and
secretary of the meeting; </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Summary of developments of the
meeting, comments at the GMS on each issue on the agenda;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Quantities of shareholders and
votes casted by shareholders that participated in the meeting, the list of
subscribed shareholders and shareholders’ representatives that participated in
the meeting and their votes;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Number of affirmative votes on
each issue, voting method, numbers of valid votes, invalid votes, affirmative
votes, negative votes and abstentions, their ratios to total number of votes of
all participants; </p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>i) Full names and signatures of the
chair and secretary of the meeting.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>In case the chair and the secretary
refuse to sign the minutes, the minutes will be effective if they are signed by
other members of the Board of Directors and contain all information prescribed
in this Clause.  The minutes shall clearly state the reasons why the chair and
the secretary refuse to sign them. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The minutes of the GMS shall be
completed and ratified before the meeting ends.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. The chair and secretary or other
persons who sign the minutes are jointly responsible for the accuracy and
truthfulness of the minutes.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The Vietnamese and foreign
language copies of the minutes have the same legal effect. In case of any
discrepancy between them, the Vietnamese copy shall prevail.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. The minutes of the GMS shall be
sent to all shareholders within 15 days from the ending date of the meeting;
the vote counting record may be uploaded to the company’s website.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. The minutes of the GMS, the list
of registered participants, the ratified resolutions and documents enclosed
with the invitations shall be retained at the company’s headquarters.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 74. Requesting
invalidation of a resolution of the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>Within 90 days from the receipt of
the resolution or minutes of the GMS or the vote counting record, the
shareholder or group of shareholders mentioned in Clause 2 Article 10 of this Charter
is entitled to request the court or an arbitral tribunal to consider
invalidating the resolution in part or in full in the following cases:</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The contents of the resolution
violates the law or the company’s charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 75. Effect of a
resolution of the GMS</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The resolution of the GMS takes
effect from the day on which it is ratified or on the effective date specified
therein.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. A resolution that is ratified by
100% of the voting shares shall be lawful and effective even if the procedures
for convening the meeting and issuing such resolution prescribed in the law and
the company's charter are not followed;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. In case a shareholder or group
of shareholders requests the court or an arbitral tribunal to consider
invalidating the resolution as prescribed in Article 74 of this charter, the
resolution shall remain effective until the effective date of the decision on
invalidation of such resolution, except for the cases in which temporary
emergency measures are implemented under a decision of a competent authority.</p><p align=center style='margin-top:6.0pt;text-align:center'><b>Board
of Directors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 76. Board of Directors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Board of Directors is the
managerial body of the company and shall act on behalf of the company to make
decisions, and perform rights and obligations of the company, except the rights
and obligations of the GMS.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The Board of Directors has the
following rights and obligations:</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Propose the types of authorized
shares and quantity of each type;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Decide the sale of certain types
of unsold authorized shares; decide other methods of raising capital;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Decide selling prices for the
company’s shares and bonds;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Decide repurchase of shares as
prescribed in Points a, b Clause 2 Article 19 of this charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Decide the investment plan and
investment projects within its jurisdiction and limitations prescribed by law;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Decide solutions for market
development, marketing and technology;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>h) Approve sale contracts, purchase
contracts, borrowing contracts, lending contracts, other contracts and
transactions that are worth at least 35% of the total assets written in the
latest financial statements of the company (excluding assets of trustors and
funds or securities investment companies managed by the company), <i>unless
another ratio or value is specified in the company's charter</i>, and contracts
and transactions within the jurisdiction of the GMS as prescribed in Point d
Clause 2 Article 62, Clause 1 and Clause 3 Article 87 of this charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>i) Elect or dismiss the Chairperson
of the Board of Directors; designate, dismiss, enter into and terminate
contracts with the Director or General Director and other key executives
specified in the company's charter; decide salaries, remunerations, bonuses and
other benefits of these executives; appoint, dismiss or replace employees of
the internal audit unit; designate authorized representatives to participate in
the Board of Members or GMS of another company; decide their remunerations and
other benefits;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>k) Supervise the General Director (Director)
and other executives managing the company’s everyday business;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>m) Approve the agenda and documents
of the GMS; convene the GMS or carry out surveys for the GMS to ratify its
resolutions;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>n) Submit annual financial
statements to the GMS;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>o) Propose the dividends; decide
the time and procedures for paying dividends or settling business losses;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>p) Propose reorganization or
dissolution or file bankruptcy of the company;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>q) Perform other rights and
obligations prescribed by the Law on Enterprises and the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. The Board of Directors shall ratify
its resolutions and decisions by voting at the meeting, questionnaire survey or
another method specified in the company's charter. Each member of the Board of
Directors shall have one vote.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. When performing its functions
and tasks, the Board of Directors shall comply with regulations of law, the
company’s charter and resolutions of the GMS.  In case a resolution or decision
is ratified by the Board of Directors against regulations of law or a
resolution of the GMS or the company’s charter and causes damage to the
company, the members that vote for the ratification of such resolution or
decision shall be jointly responsible for it and pay compensation for the
company; the members that vote against such resolution or decision shall not be
held responsible. In this case, the company’s shareholders are entitled to
request the court to suspend or invalidate the resolution or decision.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 77. Members of Board of
Directors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Board of Directors shall
have 03 – 11 members. The specific quantity of members shall be prescribed by
the company’s charter.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. In case the term of office of
all members of the Board of Directors ends at the same time, they shall remain
members of the Board of Directors until new members are elected and take over
their jobs, unless otherwise prescribed by company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The company's charter shall
specify the quantity, rights and obligations of independent members of the
Board of Directors; method for organizing and coordinating their activities.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. Organizational structure,
standards and requirements to be satisfied by members and independent members
of the Board of Directors shall be prescribed by the company’s charter in
accordance with regulations of the Law on Enterprises and the Law on
Securities. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 78. Chairperson of Board
of Directors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Board of Directors shall
elect one of its members as the Chairperson of the Board of Directors; dismiss
its Chairperson.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The Chairperson of the Board of
Directors has the following rights and obligations:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) Plan the activities of the Board
of Directors;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Draw up agenda and prepare
documents for meetings of the Board of Directors; convene and chair the
meetings;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Organize the ratification of
resolutions and decisions of the Board of Directors;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) Chair the meetings of the GMS;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Perform other rights and
obligations prescribed by the Law on Enterprises and the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. In case the Chairperson of the
Board of Directors is not present or not able to perform his/her tasks, he/she
shall authorize another member in writing to perform the rights and obligations
of the Chairperson of the Board of Directors in accordance with the company's
charter. In case no member is authorized or the Chairperson is dead, missing,
detained, serving an imprisonment sentence, serving an administrative penalty
in a correctional institution or rehabilitation center, making a getaway, has
limited legal capacity or is incapacitated, has difficulty in controlling
his/her behavior, is prohibited by the court from holding certain positions or
doing certain works, one of members of the Board of Directors shall convene a
meeting with the remaining members to elect one of them as the interim
Chairperson under the majority rule until a new decision is issued by the Board
of Directors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 79. Dismissal, discharge,
replacement and addition of members of the Board of Directors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The GMS shall dismiss a member
of the Board of Directors from office in the following cases:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) He/she does not fully satisfy
the requirements specified in Article 77 of this Charter;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) He/she hands in a resignation which
is accepted;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Other cases prescribed by the
company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. The GMS shall discharge a member
of the Board of Directors in the following cases:</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Other cases prescribed by the
company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. Where necessary, the GMS shall
replace members of the Board of Directors; dismiss or discharge members of the
Board of Directors in cases other than those specified in Clause 1 and Clause 2
of this Article.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The Board of Directors shall
convene the GMS to elect additional members of Board of Directors in the
following cases:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The number of members of the
Board of Directors decreases by more than one third of the number specified in
the company's charter. The Board of Directors shall convene the GMS within 60
days from the occurrence of such decrease;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) The number of independent
members of the Board of Directors falls below the minimum number prescribed by
law;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Except the cases specified in
Point a and Point b of this Clause, the nearest GMS shall elect new members of
the Board of Directors to replace the dismissed members.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'><b>Article 80. Meetings of the
Board of Directors</b></p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. The Chairperson of the Board of
Directors shall be elected during the first meeting of the Board of Directors
within 07 working days from the election of that Board of Directors. This
meeting shall be convened and chaired by the member that received the highest
number of votes. In case more than one member received the same highest number
of votes, one of them will be elected by the members under majority rule to
convene the meeting of the Board of Directors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. Meetings of the Board of
Directors shall be held at least quarterly and on an ad hoc basis.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) It is requested by the Board of
Controllers or independent members of the Board of Directors;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) It is requested by the Director
or General Director or at least 05 other executives;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) It is requested by at least 02
members of the Board of Directors;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Other cases prescribed by the
company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The request mentioned in Clause
3 of this Article shall be made in writing and specify the issues that need
discussing and deciding within the jurisdiction of the Board of Directors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. The Chairperson of the Board of
Directors shall convene the meeting within 07 working days from the day on
which the request mentioned in Clause 3 of this Article is received. Otherwise,
he/she shall be responsible for the damage to the company and the requesting
person is entitled to convene the meeting of the Board of Directors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>6. The Chairperson of the Board of
Directors or the person that convenes the meeting shall send the invitations to
the meeting at least 03 working days before the meeting date, unless otherwise
prescribed by the company's charter. The invitation shall specify the meeting
time, location, agenda, and issues to be discussed. The invitation shall be
enclosed with meeting documents and votes.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>The invitations can be sent
physically, by phone, fax, electronically or by other methods prescribed by the
company's charter to the registered mailing address of each member of the Board
of Directors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>7. The Chairperson of the Board of
Directors or the person that convenes the meeting shall send the same
invitations and documents to the Controllers. Controllers are entitled to
participate in meetings of the Board of Directors and discuss but must not vote.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>9. It will be considered that a
member participates in and votes at the meeting of the Board of Directors in
the following cases:</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) He/she directly participates in
and votes at the meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) He/she authorizes another person
to participate in and vote at the meeting as prescribed in Clause 11 of this
Article;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) He/she participates in the
meeting and votes online or through other electronic methods;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) He/she sends his/her vote to the
meeting by post, fax or email;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) He/she sends the votes by other
means specified in the company's charter.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>10. A vote that is sent by post
shall be put in a closed envelope and be delivered to the Chairperson of the
Board of Directors at least 01 hour before the opening time.  Votes shall only
be opened in the presence of all participants.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>11. The members shall participate
in all meetings of the Board of Directors. They may authorize other persons to
participate in and vote at the meeting if accepted by the majority of members
of the Board of Directors.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>12. Unless a higher ratio is
prescribed by the company's charter, a resolution or decision of the Board of
Directors shall be ratified if it is voted for by the majority of the
participants. In case of equality of votes, the option that is voted for by the
Chairperson of the Board of Directors shall prevail.</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>1. Minutes of all meetings of the Board
of Directors shall be taken. Audio recordings and other electronic forms are
optional. The minutes shall be taken in Vietnamese language, may be translated
into foreign languages, and shall contain the following information: </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>a) The company’s name, enterprise
ID number and headquarter address;  </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>b) Time and location of the
meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>c) Purposes and agenda of the
meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>d) Full names of participating
members or the persons authorized to participate in the meeting and how they
participate in the meeting; full names of non-participating members and their
excuses;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>dd) The issues to be discussed and
voted on at the meeting;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>e) Summary of comments of each
participating member in chronological order;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>g) Voting result, the members that
cast affirmative votes, negative votes and abstentions;</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>h) Ratified decisions and
corresponding ratio of affirmative votes;</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><p>...</p><div style="font-weight: bold;font-size: 14px;width: 400px;     margin-left: 50px;        border: 1px solid #F89B1A;     padding: 10px;     padding-top: 10px;">Hãy đăng nhập hoặc đăng ký Thành viên <font color='Red'>Pro</font> <a style="color:blue" class="clsopentLogin">tại đây</a> để xem toàn bộ văn bản tiếng Anh.</div><br/><br/><br/><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>2. In case the chair and the
minutes taker refuse to sign the minutes, the minutes will be effective if they
are signed by other members of the Board of Directors and contain all information
prescribed in Points a, b, c, d, dd, e, g and h Clause 1 of this Article. </p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>3. The chair, the minutes taker and
the persons who sign the minutes shall be responsible for the accuracy and
truthfulness of the minutes.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>4. The minutes and meeting documents
shall be retained at the company’s headquarters.</p><p style='margin-top:6.0pt'>5. The Vietnamese and foreign
language copies of the minutes have the same legal effect. In case of any
